title: Member menu clicks paint a loading face at once on routes that had none

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-09: menu clicks have always been slow. Speed pass 1, route boundary review.

detail: About fifty member routes had no loading.tsx, so a menu click kept the old screen until the next page's server reads finished, which feels like a stall. The (main) group now has a shared skeleton boundary under the shell; routes with their own loading face are unchanged. This fixes the feel, not the server time of any one page; per-page read waterfalls remain separate rows.
